description: Add an interactive HTML visualization block (creates type 'interactive'). Use for self-contained HTML with JavaScript interactivity (charts, maps, diagrams). The editor surfaces these as re-generatable AI visualizations. Use preview_html first to test. For static user-authored HTML without interactivity, use add_static_html_block.
